starter: User-supplied Duck island - starter.sb3; only sprite name normalised to player

pages.title: Place your duck
pages.test: Click the green flag. The duck faces down at the centre of the Stage. Drag it somewhere else, then click the flag again: it returns to the centre.

pages.title: Turn right
pages.test: Click the flag, then press the right arrow. The duck turns right. It stays in the centre; later, the scenery will move around it.

pages.title: Turn in every direction
pages.test: Press each arrow key separately. The duck faces right, left, down, and up when you press the matching key.

pages.title: Bob on the water
pages.test: Click the flag and leave the keys alone. The duck gently bobs up and down without drifting away.

pages.title: Bob faster when swimming
pages.test: Hold an arrow key: the duck bobs faster. Release it: the gentle bob returns. Press space: the gentle bob should continue.

pages.title: Draw a wave
pages.test: Select the wave. You should see a white ring with water visible through its middle. Adjust the oval in the paint editor if it is much larger than the duck.

pages.title: Put the wave under the duck
pages.test: Click the flag. The ring sits around the duck's base. Move the wave elsewhere and restart: it returns underneath the duck.

pages.title: Make the wave bob
pages.test: Click the flag and leave the keys alone. The wave and duck bob in opposite directions.

pages.title: Make three wave costumes
pages.test: Stop the project. Click each costume thumbnail. The ring should grow in three steps while its centre stays in the same place.

pages.title: Animate the swimming wave
pages.test: Click the flag. Hold an arrow: the ring expands repeatedly. Release it: the smallest ring returns and gently bobs. Space should not animate the ring.

pages.title: Draw a rock
pages.test: Your rock appears on the Stage. It should be about the duck's width. Use the paint editor to resize the drawing if necessary.

pages.title: Make one rock appear
pages.test: Click the flag several times. Each restart shows one rock at a new position. The duck and wave still work.

pages.title: Vary the rock sizes
pages.test: Restart several times. The rock changes size as well as position. It should stay between half and all of the size you drew.

pages.title: Make rocks while swimming
pages.test: Restart, then hold an arrow for a few seconds. Several rocks appear with gaps between them. Release the key: no new rocks should appear. Pressing space alone should not create rocks.

pages.title: Start rocks at the side edges
pages.test: Restart and hold right: new rocks appear at the right edge. Restart and hold left: they appear at the left edge. They stay there for now.

pages.title: Start rocks at the top and bottom
pages.test: Restart and hold up: rocks appear near the top. Restart and hold down: they appear near the bottom. Test one arrow key at a time.

pages.title: Move rocks sideways
pages.test: Restart and hold right. Rocks travel left across the water. Hold left: they travel right. Release the key: they stop.

pages.title: Move rocks up and down
pages.test: Restart and hold up. Rocks move down. Hold down: they move up. Try all four arrows separately and check that the scenery always moves opposite the duck's direction.

pages.title: Clear rocks at the side edges
pages.test: Restart and hold right until rocks cross the Stage. They disappear near the left edge. Restart and hold left to check the opposite edge.

pages.title: Clear rocks at every edge
pages.test: Restart and swim up, down, left, and right. Rocks disappear after passing any boundary. Release the keys: rocks still inside the water stay where they are.

pages.title: Sense a rock on the right
pages.test: Restart and steer a rock towards the duck from the right. Watch `right blocked`: it changes from `no` to `yes` when the rock is close. Rocks can still pass through for now.

pages.title: Sense a rock on the left
pages.test: Restart. Steer a rock towards the duck from the left. `left blocked` changes to `yes` as it approaches, then back to `no` after it passes. The duck should not drift sideways.

pages.title: Sense rocks above and below
pages.test: Restart and steer rocks above and below the duck. The matching monitor changes to `yes` when a rock is close. Move away and it returns to `no`; the duck still bobs around the centre.

pages.title: Stop at rocks
pages.test: Restart and steer towards a rock. It stops just before reaching the duck. Press the opposite arrow: you can swim away. Test approaches from all four directions.

pages.title: Add a lost duck
pages.test: Restart and hold an arrow. Small ducks appear among the rocks and travel across the water. They are scenery for now; touching one does not score.

pages.title: Show a rescue score
pages.test: Click the flag. A score of `0` appears at the top-left. It stays at zero until you add the rescue rule next.

pages.title: Rescue a duck
pages.test: Restart and swim into a small duck. It disappears and the score increases by exactly `1`. A rock should never award a point.

pages.title: Hear each rescue
pages.test: Rescue a small duck. You hear a pop as it disappears, and the score still increases by one.

pages.title: Add a hook
pages.test: Restart. Hooks appear alongside ducks and rocks. Touch a hook: it disappears without increasing the score. Rescue a duck: that still adds one point.

pages.title: End the game on a hook
pages.test: Restart and touch a hook. You hear a lower pop, then everything stops. The score must not increase for the hook. Click the flag to start a new game.

pages.title: Make hooks drift
pages.test: Restart and hold an arrow to create hooks. Release it: rocks and small ducks stop, but hooks keep drifting. Hooks that cross a boundary disappear; touching one still ends the game.

pages.title: Challenge: vary the rocks
pages.test: Restart and swim for a while. Both kinds of rock appear. Check that both still block the duck and disappear at the edges.

pages.title: Challenge: add water sounds
pages.test: Restart. Water sounds loop quietly while you play. You can still hear rescues and the hook sound.

pages.title: Challenge: remember your best score
pages.test: Rescue some ducks, then restart. `score` returns to zero but `high score` keeps your best result. Beat it and watch it increase.

pages.title: Challenge: give the duck three lives
pages.test: Restart and touch one hook at a time. Lives go from 3 to 2 to 1, and each hook disappears. The third hit stops the game. Restart: lives return to 3.

pages.title: Challenge: draw a game-over sign
pages.test: Click the green flag: the sign hides. Click the `when I receive game over` stack directly in the code area: the sign appears in front of the game. Restart to hide it again.

pages.title: Challenge: show the sign at game over
pages.test: Restart and lose the game. The sign appears before everything stops. Restart again: the sign hides and you can play another round.

pages.title: Challenge: tune the movement
pages.test:
Restart and create a few hooks, then release the arrows. Compare their drift with the earlier speed. Choose a speed that gives you time to dodge. Check that hooks still disappear at the edges.

Save your project.
